Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Internationalism (see English territory), ultimately from Latin territōrium.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈterːitorio/, [ˈt̪e̞rːiˌt̪o̞rio̞]
  • Rhymes: -orio
  • Syllabification(key): ter‧ri‧to‧ri‧o
  • Hyphenation(key): ter‧ri‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

territorio

  1. territory

Galician

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • território (reintegrationist)

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin territōrium, from terra.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /tɛriˈtɔɾjo/ [t̪ɛ.riˈt̪ɔ.ɾjʊ]
  • Rhymes: -ɔɾjo
  • Hyphenation: te‧rri‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

territorio m (plural territorios)

  1. territory

Related terms

[edit]
  • terra
  • territorial

Further reading

[edit]
  • “territorio”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin territōrium, from terra.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ter.riˈtɔ.rjo/
  • Audio::(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɔrjo
  • Hyphenation: ter‧ri‧tò‧rio

Noun

[edit]

territorio m (plural territori)

  1. territory
  2. precinct
  3. jurisdiction

Related terms

[edit]
  • territoriale
  • terra

Noun

[edit]

territōriō

  1. dative/ablative singular of territōrium

[edit]

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin territōrium from terra.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /teriˈtoɾjo/ [t̪e.riˈt̪o.ɾjo]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -oɾjo
  • Syllabification: te‧rri‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

territorio m (plural territorios)

  1. territory
    • 2026 January 24, Lauren Kent, “Soldados daneses que lucharon junto a EE.UU. se sienten traicionados mientras Trump amenaza a Groenlandia y denigra a la OTAN”, in CNN en Español‎[2], archived from the original on 26 January 2026:
      Apenas horas después de exigir “derecho, título y propiedad” del territorio autónomo danés el miércoles, el presidente Donald Trump dio un giro de 180 grados y anunció que había “formó el marco de un futuro acuerdo” sobre Groenlandia tras una reunión con el jefe de la OTAN, Mark Rutte.
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)
